title: sales-partnership-scratch-notes-jordan
content:
Context / purpose:
- Scratchpad for outreach to strategic partnerships (DataWave Health, Nimbus Analytics, BrightServe).
- Capture account intel, quick outbound drafts, voicemail scripts, and common objection handling. Not formalized yet - for team use.

Account: DataWave Health (enterprise healthcare analytics)
- HQ: Boston; ~1200 employees.
- Likely pain: high volume inference on clinical notes, SPoC for inference pipeline, sensitive PHI (needs private deployment + KMS).
- Possible champion: Head of ML Ops (Samir Rao) or Director of Platform (Maria Alvarez).
- Tech stack hints: AWS, Snowflake, internal feature store, Airflow.
- Procurement: long lead, security-first (SOC2/ISO needs), prefers contract + dedicated infra.
- Why Redwood resonates: predictable latency for clinician-facing apps, private deployment + HSM/KMS, cost controls for token-heavy pipelines.

Key value props to highlight:
- Private deployment option (VPC / on-prem) + KMS/HSM integrations for PHI compliance.
- Predictable latency SLA for clinician-facing apps (can demo latency numbers vs seq lengths).
- Cost optimization (batching, KV caching, quantization recommendations) - helpful for large-scale inference.
- Rollout controls / canary + automatic fallback to safe models.

Outbound email drafts (A/B test):
A) Short, direct
Subject: Reducing inference cost & latency for DataWave's clinical models
Hi Samir -
Quick question: are you the person responsible for production LLMs at DataWave? We've helped healthcare analytics teams reduce per-token cost by ~35% while keeping latency under 150ms for EHR prompts using a private deployment. If you're open, I can share a one-page summary + perf numbers relevant to clinical note use cases.
Thanks,
Jordan Kim

B) Value-first with CTA
Subject: Private LLM inference + KMS for PHI-sensitive pipelines
Hi Maria -
We work with healthcare analytics platforms to run sensitive LLM workloads in a VPC with customer-managed keys and audit logs. Would you be open to a quick 20-min call to review how we integrate with Snowflake & Airflow and what the cost profile looks like? I can bring a short case study from a customer in Boston.
Best,
Jordan

Voicemail (30s)
- Hi Samir, this is Jordan Kim from Redwood Inference. We help healthcare analytics teams get predictable latency and PHI-safe inference via private deployments and KMS. I'd love 15 minutes to share a short perf/cost benchmark for clinical note models - call me back at (415) 555-0192 or reply to my email. Thanks.

Quick follow-up cadence (templated)
- Day 0: send A (short)
- Day 3: send B (value + case study)
- Day 7: LinkedIn + voicemail
- Day 14: final note w/ ask to connect or intro to procurement

Objections & suggested responses (bullet-style)
1) "We can self-host, don't need a vendor."
- Response: Totally - many teams self-host but still want a unified control plane and optimizations (batching, KV caching, quant profiles) to reduce operational overhead. Redwood can run in VPC/private env and hand over ops details or run as managed dedicated capacity. Helps accelerate time-to-prod without redoing infra.

2) "Security/compliance concerns (PHI)."
- Response: We support private deployments, KMS/HSM key control, audit logs, and can provide SOC2 artifacts. Offer a security walkthrough with SRE + product security.

3) "Cost - vendor fees + infra add up."
- Response: Point to Redwood Optimize: batching + quantization can reduce per-token cost materially; we provide a model-by-workload recommendation and can run a cost estimate using a short sampling trace. Offer to run a free perf/cost pilot for a single endpoint.

4) "Latency-sensitive clinician UI - worried about tail latencies."
- Response: Highlight runtime: attention optimizations, continuous batching, and canary/fallback routes. Offer to share latency percentiles from similar deployments and set up an SLO review.

Internal ask list / experiments:
- Ask engineering (Ryan): grab a 1-hour perf sample from hosted-prod to show example cost calc for clinical-note prompt shapes.
- Ask solutions eng (Danielle): prepare a 1-pager for DataWave with private deploy + KMS flow diagram and integration notes for Snowflake/Airflow.
- Prep a short benchmark slide (1 slide) showing latency p50/p95 and cost per 1M tokens for typical EHR prompt.

Potential next steps / call agenda (20m)
- 3 min intros + context on DataWave use of LLMs
- 5 min high-level Redwood architecture (private deploy, KMS, audit)
- 7 min perf/cost bench tailored to their prompt shapes
- 3 min security + procurement discussion (SOC2, contract length)
- 2 min outcomes & next steps (pilot scope, stakeholders)

Notes / quick brainstorms:
- If they mention regulators, ask whether they need on-prem vs VPC - prioritize KMS + audit logs.
- If procurement is a blocker, propose a timeboxed pilot with limited data scope and predefined success metrics (latency, cost).
- Consider co-selling narrative: Redwood + Solutions Eng provide initial pilot; handoff to Dedicated sales for reserved capacity if pilot succeeds.

To capture after the call:
- Who attended (names + titles)
- Primary blocker (security, cost, time-to-prod)
- Pilot scope & timeline
- Next meeting date / decision owner

Tasks (triage)
- [Jordan] finalize 1-pager for DataWave (due: 2026-03-05)
- [Danielle] security artifact pack + SOC2 excerpt (due: 2026-03-08)
- [Ryan] run cost calc sample & share numbers (due: 2026-03-04)
- [Olivia] draft calendar invite + intro note to Samir

---
End of scratch notes.
